layers.title: System Governor
layers.objective: Score every sleeve by health, evidence, cost, risk, freshness, and dependency posture.

layers.title: Evidence Court
layers.objective: Require point-in-time promotion packets before training, paper promotion, or budget expansion.

layers.title: Memory And Storage Triage
layers.objective: Downgrade collection capture from raw trace to digest, heartbeat, or parked as pressure rises.

layers.title: Backlog Intelligence
layers.objective: Track whether drainer and organizer actions reduce pressure instead of only moving backlog around.

layers.title: Sleeve Economy
layers.objective: Give sleeves pressure-aware CPU, memory, storage, freshness, and operator-attention budgets.

layers.title: Self-Model Upgrade
layers.objective: Keep a living map of bots, surfaces, stale signals, dependency edges, and unknowns.

layers.title: Operator Interface
layers.objective: Compress blockers, safe actions, risk, evidence gaps, and next commands into one packet.

layers.title: Clean Scaling Control
layers.objective: Require raw/live headroom, overlay debt, storage mode, runtime, provider quality, and admission evidence to agree before growth.
